title: Azure Pipelines Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

descriptions.value: In chppWifiRangingEventNotification of clients/wifi.c, there is a possible Heap Buffer Overflow due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) escalation of privilege with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.
